display.purpose: Home greeting headline and the Done screen. Weight 800, up to 2.6rem.

headline.purpose: The exercise/step title on each flow screen.

title.purpose: Section titles on the full-plan and safety reference pages.

body.purpose: All reading copy and cues. 1.15rem on an 18px root, capped ~65-75ch.

shadows.name: ambient-soft

shadows.name: ambient-lifted

components.name: Start / Next Button (Go)
components.description: The single most important action on a screen: Start Workout, Next.
components.css: .ds-btn-go { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.6rem; width: 100%; min-height: 4.4rem; padding: 1rem 1.4rem; font-family: Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 700; color: oklch(1 0 0); background: oklch(0.52 0.13 152); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 18px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0.4 0.03 255 / 0.06), 0 6px 20px oklch(0.4 0.03 255 / 0.08); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-go:hover { background: oklch(0.46 0.13 152); } .ds-btn-go:active { transform: scale(0.985); } .ds-btn-go:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.50 0.11 250); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Standard forward action in the confident-blue guide color.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.6rem; width: 100%; min-height: 3.75rem; padding: 1rem 1.4rem; font-family: Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 700; color: oklch(1 0 0); background: oklch(0.50 0.11 250); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 18px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.44 0.11 250); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.985); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.50 0.11 250); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Back and secondary actions; transparent with a stronger hairline.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.6rem; min-height: 3.75rem; padding: 1rem 1.4rem; font-family: Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 700; color: oklch(0.25 0.02 255); background: transparent; border: 1px solid oklch(0.82 0.015 245); border-radius: 18px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(0.978 0.006 245); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.985); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.50 0.11 250); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Vital Card
components.description: The big sets-x-reps / effort readouts on an exercise screen.
components.css: .ds-vital { display: block; background: oklch(0.978 0.006 245); border: 1px solid oklch(0.90 0.012 245); border-radius: 18px; padding: 1rem 1.1rem; font-family: Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-vital-label { display: block; font-size: 0.92rem; font-weight: 700; color: oklch(0.42 0.02 255); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; } .ds-vital-big { display: block; font-size: 1.9rem; font-weight: 800; color: oklch(0.25 0.02 255); margin-top: 0.15rem; line-height: 1.1; } .ds-vital-sub { display: block; font-size: 0.95rem; color: oklch(0.42 0.02 255); }

components.name: Do-This Block
components.description: Green 'do this' cue block with hand-drawn check marks.
components.html:
Do this
  • Sit tall, feet flat and firm
  • Push smoothly, breathe out on effort
components.css: .ds-do { border-radius: 18px; padding: 1.15rem 1.2rem; background: oklch(0.95 0.045 152); border: 1px solid oklch(0.72 0.09 152); font-family: Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-do-head { font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.15rem; color: oklch(0.46 0.13 152); margin-bottom: 0.7rem; } .ds-do ul { margin: 0; padding-left: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-do li { position: relative; padding-left: 2.2rem; margin-bottom: 0.7rem; font-size: 1.12rem; line-height: 1.5; color: oklch(0.25 0.02 255); } .ds-do li:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; } .ds-do li::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0.15rem; top: 0.35rem; width: 1.15rem; height: 0.6rem; border-left: 3px solid oklch(0.46 0.13 152); border-bottom: 3px solid oklch(0.46 0.13 152); transform: rotate(-45deg); }

components.name: Avoid Block
components.description: Amber common-mistakes block with cross markers.
components.html:
Avoid
  • Locking the knees or joints hard
  • Rushing or jerking the weight
components.css: .ds-avoid { border-radius: 18px; padding: 1.15rem 1.2rem; background: oklch(0.965 0.045 82); border: 1px solid oklch(0.83 0.12 80); font-family: Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-avoid-head { font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.15rem; color: oklch(0.44 0.10 62); margin-bottom: 0.7rem; } .ds-avoid ul { margin: 0; padding-left: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-avoid li { position: relative; padding-left: 2.2rem; margin-bottom: 0.7rem; font-size: 1.12rem; line-height: 1.5; color: oklch(0.25 0.02 255); } .ds-avoid li:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; } .ds-avoid li::before { content: '✕'; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0.05rem; width: 1.6rem; height: 1.6rem; display: grid; place-items: center; background: oklch(0.90 0.08 80); color: oklch(0.44 0.10 62); font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.9rem; border-radius: 999px; }

components.name: Danger Callout
components.description: Red 'stop and see a professional' warning; rare by design.
components.html: Stop and rest if…You feel sharp joint pain, dizziness, or chest tightness.
components.css: .ds-danger { border-radius: 18px; padding: 1.15rem 1.2rem; background: oklch(0.965 0.03 25); border: 1px solid oklch(0.78 0.10 25); font-family: Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.08rem; line-height: 1.55; color: oklch(0.25 0.02 255); } .ds-danger b { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.35rem; font-size: 1.12rem; color: oklch(0.45 0.16 25); }

components.name: Effort Meter
components.description: Plain-language stand-in for RPE: segmented pills that fill green.
components.html: Working, but you could say a short sentence
components.css: .ds-effort { font-family: Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-effort .ds-meter { display: flex; gap: 0.3rem; margin: 0.4rem 0 0.35rem; } .ds-effort .ds-meter i { height: 0.85rem; flex: 1; border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(0.955 0.009 245); } .ds-effort .ds-meter i.on { background: oklch(0.52 0.13 152); } .ds-effort-sub { color: oklch(0.25 0.02 255); font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.95rem; }

narrative.overview: Everything here behaves like a trusted person walking beside you, one step at a time. The system never rushes, never crowds, and never assumes you already know the way. Screens hold a single idea at a time on a comfortable phone-width column of calm white, at a deliberately oversized scale, because the one person who uses this is 50+ and does not use technology often. The palette is a pure-white daylight carrying a single deep, confident blue for guidance, with a tightly-governed safety vocabulary: green means go, amber means be careful, red means stop. Warmth comes from Figtree's humanist letterforms and generous rounding, not from a tinted background. The result should read as reassuring and human, a guide, not a gym.
keyCharacteristics: Oversized type and >=60px tap targets for older eyes and hands.
Pure-white daylight surface; one blue guide color; strict semantic safety colors.
Plain language, always. No jargon, no abbreviations, no hidden affordances.
Injury prevention is the north star of the content; the visual system makes cues and warnings impossible to miss.

rules.name: The Traffic-Light Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, and red are reserved for safety meaning (go, caution, stop) and never used decoratively.

rules.name: The One-Blue Rule
rules.body: There is exactly one guide color. Blue leads the eye to the next action and the current position; never decoration that competes with a real cue.

rules.name: The Pure-White Rule
rules.body: The body background is pure white, never a cream, sand, or warm-tinted near-white. Warmth is carried by type and rounding.

rules.name: The One-Voice Rule
rules.body: One family, Figtree, everywhere. Hierarchy comes from weight and size, never from a new typeface.

rules.name: The Read-It-Once Rule
rules.body: Nothing that must be understood drops below body size (1.15rem on an 18px root). Body and cues are always sentence case and plain-spoken.

rules.name: The Soft-Lift Rule
rules.body: Shadows are soft, blue-tinted, and ambient; flat by default, lift only what the user should act on.

dos: Do keep one idea per screen and one clearly-dominant action (the green or blue button).
Do keep the body pure white and carry warmth through Figtree and rounding.
Do honor the Traffic-Light Rule: green = proceed/correct/done, amber = caution, red = stop.
Do keep every tap target >= 60px and body text >= 1.15rem.
Do keep ink-soft (oklch(0.42 0.02 255)) as the lightest text on white, dark enough for ~4.5:1.
Do contain (never crop) the demo GIF, and show the filename-naming placeholder when a GIF is missing.
Do write in plain, sentence-case language a first-time user understands on sight.
donts: Don't make it look like a gym, a fitness tracker, or a clinical/medical form.
Don't use jargon or abbreviations (never 'RPE'); the effort meter and plain words replace numeric scales.
Don't introduce a second font family, a gradient headline, or a tiny tracked uppercase eyebrow above sections.
Don't use a cream/sand/warm-tinted background in place of pure white.
Don't spend green, amber, or red on decoration, and don't let coral become a second brand color.
Don't hide actions behind menus, swipes, or discoverable gestures.
Don't use hard/dark drop shadows; lift is soft, blue-tinted, and ambient.
